I didn't recognize that error message from radv/amdgpu so I did a quick google search. It seems like there are a lot of issues with Arch Linux and the amdvlk drivers. 

Now more importantly, the print from Godot seems to indicate that you are using the RADV drivers, not amdvlk. So it seems the issue is that you have both the amdvlk and the RADV drivers installed. The contents of `/usr/share/vulkan/icd.d/` indicate that as well. 

You should uninstall the amdvlk drivers and only use one set of drivers. You will probably need to uninstall amdvlk and then reinstall RADV since having both side by side has clearly messed up your driver config. 

This isn't a Godot specific problem by the way. Just searching the error message led me to someone with the same problem with a totally different piece of software https://github.com/an-anime-team/an-anime-game-launcher/issues/559

Cool! Thanks for pointing me in the right direction. I uninstalled lib32-amdvlk and amdvlk and the issue is gone now.

I actually read today AMD is abandoning amdvlk and I don't think I have ran it for games in long either.
https://www.phoronix.com/news/AMDVLK-Discontinued

For those finding this issue through search and looking for a quick one-line solution:

```
sudo pacman -S vulkan-radeon lib32-vulkan-radeon && sudo pacman -R amdvlk lib32-amdvlk
```

This installs the Mesa RADV driver and then uninstalls the discontinued AMDVLK driver.
